verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud platform with a programmatic surface, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file, the Markdown docs, the SDKs and the CLI are related features, not an OpenAPI-style API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
